details: This package is a rebranded clone of the Baileys WhatsApp library with an injected channel-enrolment payload. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, inside makeNewsletterSocket() and therefore on the core message-send path (lib/Socket/messages-send.js builds its socket from it), a 120-second timer fetches a remote JSON list from hxxps://raw[.]githubusercontent[.]com/pipih071/SilenceV3/refs/heads/main/strings[.]json and treats each entry as a WhatsApp channel JID. It then issues newsletter FOLLOW queries (IQ to S_WHATSAPP_NET, xmlns w:mex, variables {newsletter_id: <jid>}) one at a time with an 11-second stagger, silently subscribing the authenticated user's WhatsApp account to every channel in that list. The list is attacker-controlled and can be changed without republishing the package, and all errors are swallowed so the enrolment is invisible to the user. lib/Utils/messages.js additionally embeds a fixed channel reference 120363421402022543@newsletter labelled "Telegram: @dgxeon13" into the context of outbound messages. The only lifecycle hook, preinstall running engine-requirements.js, merely checks that the Node.js major version is 20 or higher. There is no credential, token or wallet theft; the payload manipulates the WhatsApp account state of the installer.
